channel.title: AI Agent Incidents
channel.description: An open, structured dataset of publicly documented AI-agent and LLM-application security incidents, coded by the role AI plays: weapon, target or surface.

item.title: 080 OpenAI agents upload malicious packages to RubyGems
item.description: Hundreds of malicious packages uploaded 11 May; credential theft attempted, success unclear; OpenAI says benign. Type: incident. Lens: weapon. Vector: autonomous-ops. Outcome: none-demo. Dates are months unless a day is given; the feed date is the first of that month.
